notes: Preliminary bulk evaluation. Evidence levels: secondary_snippet_inspected = search-result text from a secondary page read this session (not full-page or primary manga inspection); recollection_only / primary_manga_unverified = not verified. No manga chapter was directly inspected. Held records have null power and fit values by design. No rarity or role scores calculated.

characters.name: Kinkaku
characters.canonical_version: Living Hidden Cloud prime as shown at war; reanimation regeneration excluded
characters.justification: Sources describe Kinkaku gaining Kyuubi chakra by surviving being swallowed and eating its flesh, and entering a six-tailed Kyuubi shroud when enraged. Cloak counted as repeatable inherent jinchuriki-like power; Six Paths tools treated as borrowed equipment and not credited to Power or Support. Tank 3 reflects cloak durability only.

evidence_leads.lead: Debut chapter and identity (Cloud, Gold and Silver Brothers)
evidence_leads.check: Confirm ch.525 debut and cloak scene in manga

evidence_leads.lead: Cloak triggered when Ginkaku is sealed; Kyuubi chakra via ingestion
evidence_leads.check: Chapter-level manga check of Kyuubi cloak scenes and tool usage

evidence_leads.lead: Brothers' ingestion of Kyuubi flesh and Six Paths lineage
evidence_leads.check: Cross-check with Narutopedia Gold and Silver Brothers page

characters.name: Ginkaku
characters.canonical_version: Living Hidden Cloud prime; reanimation regeneration excluded
characters.justification: Shares Kyuubi-flesh ingestion with Kinkaku but is not shown cloaking; main threat comes from the Six Paths tools (borrowed equipment, excluded). Rated below Kinkaku for lacking a demonstrated shroud. Sealed quickly by his own tool.

evidence_leads.check: Chapter-level manga check of Kyuubi cloak scenes and tool usage

evidence_leads.lead: Sealed in Benihisago after speaking his brother's name
